experiments.harness_commit: 632c3d433 frozen reporting harness plus admission of leaf feature masks 32 and 160; identical copy for both variants

plan.description: Single-branch veneer fusion over graduated 21c322713, with limit 32 and forward-only leaf expansion retained. Candidate adds existing feature bit 32 to literal-PC bit 128. Both games, frozen ABBA/BAAB and measured host-validity rules.
